nameJa: 映像が透けるチャット
conceptNote: 全画面の映像を表す幾何学模様がチャットの背後に透け、動画と会話を同時に楽しめる構造を示す。
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: refined, wordless Chrome Web Store discovery tile explaining fullscreen video with transparent live chat overlay.
Create ONE finished landscape image at aspect ratio 11:7, target 1760 x 1120. The whole composition is a large flat midnight-navy video rectangle floating in a narrow warm-white margin. A thin coral diagonal ribbon and one restrained muted-blue circle pass behind a chat overlay to demonstrate transparency; these are deliberately abstract graphic shapes, NOT scenery. A small elegant white play triangle lies clearly in the left half of the video.
Overlay a tall narrow translucent charcoal chat card INSIDE the right side of the video. The card takes about 28 percent of video width, inset from all edges. Underlying coral ribbon and muted circle remain subtly visible THROUGH it, but chat shapes stay clear. Put five generously spaced message rows inside: muted avatar circles plus white horizontal rounded strokes of different lengths. Place a blank rounded composer and simple send-arrow shape at the base. All strokes are geometric marks, never glyphs or pseudo-text.
Four large thin warm-white fullscreen corner brackets sit at the four OUTERMOST corners of the entire video rectangle, outside the overlay. Both right corner brackets are at the FAR RIGHT beyond the chat card, never at its left seam. This must read immediately as ONE fullscreen video containing a translucent chat overlay.
Style: premium Swiss editorial infographic, extremely crisp deliberate vector-like edges, flat restrained colors, careful whitespace, asymmetrical composition, 2D. The abstract video surface occupies 90 percent of the tile with a clear margin. Avoid any words, lettering, numbers, symbols resembling words, labels, watermarks, browser chrome, window controls, physical screens, bevels, 3D, gradients, glows, landscapes, people, mountains, sunsets. No text anywhere.
